data.name: Martguerita
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Italian name Marta, meaning 'Mary', and the suffix -gerita, meaning 'little shepherdess'. This name carries the significance of Mary's role as a shepherdess of souls and the protector of her flock in Christian tradition.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and nurturing love.
data.numerology_meaning: Innovative, intuitive, and highly sensitive individuals who tend to inspire and motivate others.

data.cultural_impact: Martguerita is an Italian-origin name that holds a rich cultural legacy. As mentioned, the name is derived from Marta, a name associated with Saint Martha, who is celebrated in Christian tradition. Saint Martha is known for her faith, hospitality, and her role as a shepherdess of souls. This name carries the cultural significance of strong Christian faith and Italian heritage.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Martguerita holds a deep spiritual significance as it reflects the Namesake's (Saint Martha's) role as a shepherdess of souls. Mary, being the epitome of faith and protection in Christianity, is represented as a shepherdess, guiding and nurturing her flock just as Martha did. This name is a reminder of the spiritual responsibility we all have to care for our fellow beings and guide them on their spiritual journey.
